_comment: pico-stretch2 review config. Currents: RP2350 core via VREG up to 200 mA (datasheet 6.3), VREG_VIN draw ~0.1 A; RM2 Tx 271 mA typ (RM2 datasheet 1.2) -> 0.35 A peak used; 3V3 pin user load 0.3 A (Pico spec); flash/PSRAM 25 mA each. USB VBUS 0.9 A worst (radio + 3V3 out + VBUS passthrough). Review 2 (2026-10-29): same classes and runs as review/pack, plus diff-pair target and decoupling limit; thermal and islands added after the first build.
